acceptanceCriteria: The revisions member uses a generic role name (e.g. e2e) on output, with the old key accepted as a compatibility alias on input under a recorded deprecation.
A test asserts no adopter-specific key appears in emitted vocabulary and that old inputs still decode.
body: internal/doccorpus/behavior.go BehaviorRevisions serializes its E2E member under a key derived from one adopter's repository name instead of a generic role, contrary to DCP-V1-032 (new mapping/result vocabulary contains no adopter-specific repository, product or path terms). Source: beamfall/corvint#717.
title: docs corpus: BehaviorRevisions serializes the e2e member under an adopter-specific JSON key
